caption: The drawing depicts a single Victorian-style women's boot set against a plain, light beige background. The upper portion of the boot is covered in a black and white houndstooth pattern fabric, and features a row of black buttons running diagonally from the instep to the top of the ankle, each button held by a fabric loop. The lower part of the boot, encompassing the toe and heel areas, is made of darker material, likely black or very dark brown leather. The boot has a slightly pointed toe and an arched sole with a medium-high, curved heel that is brown on the inner side. There are no additional objects, and the only other visible markings are a small handwritten note in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Woman's Shoe
